INT-deletion-managed-media adversarial review of HEAD 2994371e1c5edf9a1e9bb12f6c6e4751e3fb4ea1 (branch devin/1788854799-production-program-integration). Attack branch devin/pp/adv/deletion-managed-media-2994371e pushed at a83fc5a4ee8d7c9ca095ddea3cff940ec52b3d1b; `git diff --stat 2994371e a83fc5a4` = 6 new test files, 2096 insertions, 0 production/existing-test changes; no PR opened. attacks_tried=61 = 27 mobile Jest cases + 16 Edge Deno cases + 6 media-worker vitest cases + 12 SQL attack groups (60 assertions). All log artifacts are in the checkout under artifacts/adv-deletion-managed-media/ (gitignored, not committed).

CONFIRMED BREAKS (5, all P1, listed in `breaks`): mobile lost-final-response no status recovery; mobile 202 in_progress not handled / no operationId on retry; mobile process-death/relaunch cannot resume; durable deletion foundation unused by any shipping module; media-worker final_hard_delete stalls forever on a drill-referenced original.

ATTACKS THAT DID NOT BREAK (VERIFIED, passing = evidence):
- Edge (Deno): `cd supabase/functions/api/__wf__ && deno test -A --no-check --config deno.json adv_deletion_unknown_state.test.ts` → exit 0, 16 passed, 0 failed, 0 ignored (artifacts/adv-deletion-managed-media/adv-deno-attack.log). Holds: 'completed' claim with non-allowlisted Apple outcome or malformed receipt timestamp is never reported as deletion; Auth deleted but receipt reads blocked/in_progress → unverified, never deleted:true; receipt read throwing after Auth delete stays unverified and does NOT loop into a second Auth delete; claim naming a different operationId refused before provider calls; malformed lease token / missing Apple ciphertext never starts provider work; transient Apple failure releases lease, nothing downstream; permanent Apple refusal → apple_unrevocable checkpoint + manual_action_required receipt; DB refusing apple_unrevocable fails closed (no RevenueCat, no Auth delete); lease stolen between checkpoints stops worker before Auth delete; resume after external_complete never repeats Apple/RevenueCat; non-'intent_recorded' intent RPC blocks Auth delete; tampered completed status record never a 200 completion; malformed capability/body shapes never reach RPC; pagination: exactly INVENTORY_MAX_PAGES (1000) full pages is INCOMPLETE (fail closed), one fewer is COMPLETE; cursor-ignoring source caught on page 2. Formatting/typecheck of the new file: `deno fmt --check --config deno.json adv_deletion_unknown_state.test.ts` exit 0; `deno check --config deno.json adv_deletion_unknown_state.test.ts` exit 0. Full existing Edge suite with the new file present: `deno task test` → exit 0, 849 passed (31 steps), 0 failed, 58 ignored (the 58 ignored are pre-existing DB-gated tests that require XC_PG_URL; none of the 16 adversarial cases were ignored) — artifacts/adv-deletion-managed-media/adv-deno-full.log.
- Mobile (Jest) passing cases inside `npx jest --ci __tests__/adv/` (23 passed of 27): double tap on 'Permanently delete' sends exactly one confirmation; slow confirm past the 15s deadline reported as unknown, never kept/deleted; malformed delete-request payload never arms a confirmation; 409 deletion_in_progress on a fresh request keeps the account (nothing armed, nothing purged); local SQLite purge (apps/mobile/__tests__/adv/localPurgeIsolation.adv.test.ts, 5/5): owner A purge leaves owner B rows and kv keys intact, every owner_key table and owner-qualified kv builder is covered, mid-purge SQLite failure rolls back atomically and retry completes, empty-owner purge is a no-op, hostile owner key cannot widen the purge (bound parameter). Full mobile suite with attack files present: `cd apps/mobile && npx jest --ci --silent` → exit 1 solely due to the 4 intentional attack failures: Test Suites 2 failed, 1 skipped (pre-existing), 322 passed; Tests 4 failed, 1 skipped (pre-existing), 6424 passed, 6429 total (artifacts/adv-deletion-managed-media/adv-mobile-jest-full.log). `cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit` → exit 0, 0 errors (artifacts/adv-deletion-managed-media/adv-mobile-tsc.log). Note: the VM's pre-installed apps/mobile/node_modules was stale vs package-lock (missing @sentry/react-native → 21 tsc errors); after the required `npm ci` (exit 0) tsc is clean — environment issue, not a code finding.
- media-worker passing cases (5 of 6, same command as break #5): owner isolation (purging owner A never touches owner B live or soft-deleted objects); consented ml_dataset item cleanup lets hard-delete complete; sweep page cap: 60 soft-deleted clips with one poison object all purge within bounded LIMIT 50 sweeps (≥59 purged, exactly the poison row left); restart mid-deletion: final_hard_delete left 'processing' by a crash still waits for outstanding steps. Baseline before attacks: `npx vitest run` → exit 0, 13 files, 59 tests passed.
- SQL: `docker exec -i adv-pg psql -U postgres -d adv_fresh -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < supabase/tests/adv_deletion_owner_isolation.sql` → exit 0, 'ADV SQL assertions passed: 60' (artifacts/adv-deletion-managed-media/adv-sql-attack.log; adv_fresh = shim_auth.sql + all supabase/migrations applied in order). Holds: direct DML cannot stamp a requested operation completed; non-allowlisted Apple outcomes / free-text error strings rejected by check constraints; invented or out-of-order RPC checkpoints raise 22023; cross-owner lease/operation attempts fenced; permanent Apple refusal only via apple_unrevocable + manual_action_required and rejected once ciphertext is gone; restart after apple_unrevocable reuses Apple completion and rejects stale lease; status stays in_progress with no receipt before Auth deletion; deleting owner 21 leaves owner 22/23 row counts unchanged across every FK-bound owner column plus the no-FK tables (offline_allocation_ledger, offline_allocation_identity_links, account_deletion_operations); only the deleted owner's rows are removed, durable receipt remains and carries exactly {state, completionReceipt, appleAuthorizationRevocation}; capabilities never cross owners; repeated request after completion creates no second operation; a Google/no-Apple-credential owner cannot be marked revoked or manual_action_required. Existing matrix: `./supabase/tests/run_rls_tests.sh` → exit 0 across all 4 migration histories (fresh, production_20260906, upstream_20260906, ordered_20260907), 'W08 SQL assertions passed: 111' each, 'Analysis release policy authority: PASS' (artifacts/adv-deletion-managed-media/adv-rls-run.log).
- Frozen Edge typecheck: `npx --yes deno@2.5.6 check --node-modules-dir=none --frozen --lock=deno.lock supabase/functions/api/index.ts` → exit 0 (artifacts/adv-deletion-managed-media/adv-edge-check.log).
- Lint/format of new tests: `npx prettier --check apps/mobile/__tests__/adv/ services/media-worker/test/adv.deletion-referenced-originals.test.ts` → exit 0; `npx eslint <same files>` → exit 0 (artifacts/adv-deletion-managed-media/adv-prettier.log, adv-eslint.log).
